TABLE.NAME: tutoom
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the tutoom activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Room type: 0=room+recordings, 1=room only, 2=recording only

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: External group identifier for organizing rooms (maps to API groupId)

FIELD.NAME: roomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tutoom room UUID from API (null if room not yet created)

FIELD.NAME: welcome_message
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom welcome message shown to participants

FIELD.NAME: recording_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether recording is enabled for this room (0=disabled, 1=enabled)

FIELD.NAME: recording_autostart
FIELD.COMMENT: Auto-start recording when first moderator joins (0=manual, 1=auto)

FIELD.NAME: participants
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded participant role rules for determining moderator/viewer access

TABLE.NAME: tutoom_logs
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores room activity events and audit trail

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course ID

FIELD.NAME: tutoomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tutoom activity instance ID

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User ID who triggered the event

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when event occurred

FIELD.NAME: roomid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tutoom room UUID

FIELD.NAME: event_type
FIELD.COMMENT: Event type: CREATE_ROOM, JOIN_ROOM, END_ROOM

FIELD.NAME: event_data
FIELD.COMMENT: Additional event metadata in JSON format
